productName: AIA Voluntary Health Insurance Flexi Scheme

trends.whatProductOffers: A VHIS-certified reimbursement plan with no annual benefit limit and no lifetime benefit limit, plus guaranteed lifetime renewal.
exclusionsOrConditions: No annual or lifetime limit applies to the certified benefits, but per-item sublimits in the benefit schedule still apply.
Psychiatric treatments are excluded from the worldwide cover.
Supplemental major medical benefits are expressed per disability per policy year.
Premium is not guaranteed and can be adjusted by the insurer.

wants a savings or investment element
clientProfileFit: Existing VHIS Standard Plan holders upgrading
trends.talkingPointTemplate: For {client_detail}, there is no annual or lifetime benefit limit and renewal is guaranteed for life, so the cover does not expire.

trends.whatProductOffers: Premiums qualify for VHIS tax deduction of up to HKD8,000 per insured person in each assessment year, where the insured is the taxpayer or a specified relative, with no cap on the number of specified relatives.

keyFigures.label: Tax deduction
keyFigures.value: Up to HKD8,000 per insured person

keyFigures.label: Eligible insured
keyFigures.condition: as defined in the Inland Revenue Ordinance

keyFigures.label: Cap on relatives
keyFigures.condition: no cap on the number of specified relatives

exclusionsOrConditions: The insured must be the taxpayer or a specified relative as defined in the Inland Revenue Ordinance.
Tax deduction reduces assessable income; it is not a direct deduction from tax payable.
The HKD8,000 applies per insured person, not per policy.
The policyholder must be the taxpayer.
